english.note: Use this for the literal large, violent whirlpool; it is the natural physical equivalent.
This is the all-purpose choice for a whirlpool or vortex, and also for a chaotic or drawing-in figurative force.

examples.english: A huge maelstrom suddenly appeared on the sea, and the boats immediately turned around.
The typhoon turned the surface of the sea into a huge vortex.
examples.traditional: 颱風將海面捲成一個大漩渦。
